assets.name: lantern-paper
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production transparent PNG asset for a handmade woodland paper-cut collage website. Style: tactile layered cut construction-paper illustration, irregular hand-cut organic edges, subtle visible paper fibres, flat frontal shapes with restrained layering shadows only within the object. Palette deep navy ink #20384a, muted olive #6c7950 and sage #a8b48a, warm cream #f3e8c6, mustard ochre #d8b344, natural caramel wood. Crisp clean edges and readable silhouette. Avoid photorealism, plastic 3D, black outlines, watercolor blurring, gradients painted on backgrounds, text, badges, borders and framing. Background must be genuinely transparent, no ground rectangle, no white matte. Object fills 85% of canvas with generous safety margin. One beautiful small hanging camping lantern as an isolated single object, frontal view. Deep navy cut-paper frame with an arched loop handle, modest peaked cap, elegant crossed struts, warm pale golden paper glass and tiny ochre flame visible at center. Slight handmade asymmetry, embossed layered paper grain. Whole handle and base visible. NO exterior glow: glow will be added in code. Tall lantern, near square canvas.
